champions.name: Aatrox
tips: Land the edges of your Q (The Darkin Blade) for the full slash damage from both ends.
Use Q3 to knock enemies up; combo with Umbral Dash (E) to dash toward or away during the cast.
Your passive heals based on damage dealt to champions, so engage when you can hit multiple targets.
Save E (Umbral Dash) to dodge skillshots, not just for repositioning in combat.

champions.name: Ahri
tips: Use Charm (E) before all-in to guarantee your combo lands.
Spirit Rush (R) resets if you get a takedown, useful for chain-killing low HP targets.
Orb of Deception (Q) deals magic damage going out and true damage coming back, prioritize landing the return.
Use Q to last hit casters under turret thanks to the true damage on return.

champions.name: Akali
tips: Stand inside your Twilight Shroud (W) to become untargetable from ranged abilities.
Use Shuriken Flip (E) to reset auto-attack timer and reposition mid-combo.
Energy management is key early; avoid spamming Q to poke.
Save R2 (second cast of Perfect Execution) to finish off fleeing targets.

champions.name: Akshan
tips: Hide in bushes or behind minions to gain camouflage from passive.
Revive allies by killing the champion who scored a takedown on them within range.
Use Q's bounce to hit two targets, prioritize squishies on the second bounce.
Use W (Going Rogue) to scout and harass from a distance with reduced cooldown on takedowns.

champions.name: Alistar
tips: Combo Pulverize (W) into Headbutt (Q) to knock enemies into your turret or team.
Use Flash + combo to catch enemies off guard in lane.
Ultimate (R) timing is crucial - use it to survive burst combos, not just to engage.
Headbutt allies into safety when they're about to die.

champions.name: Amumu
tips: Curse of the Sad Mummy (R) is your main engage; flash into range for surprise ults.
Bandage Toss (Q) can be used to gap-close onto enemies or escape.
Tantrum (E) reduces incoming physical damage, build around tanky bruiser items.
Try to hit as many champions as possible with your ultimate for max value.

champions.name: Anivia
tips: Use Crystallize (E) to wall off enemies or block skillshots/escape routes.
Flash Frost (Q) detonation deals more damage, try to recast it on top of enemies.
Glacial Storm (R) drains mana but slows and damages over time - toggle wisely.
Your passive lets you respawn an egg form if you die, position aggressively when you have it up.

champions.name: Annie
tips: Track your passive (Pyromania) stacks - every 4th spell stuns.
Save your stun for when you flash in or when enemies engage on you.
Tibbers (R) can be reactivated to make him leap and deal AoE damage.
Use Disintegrate (Q) for cs and poke, mana refunds on kill.

champions.name: Aphelios
tips: Learn the 5 weapon combos - Calibrum (sniper) + Severum (lifesteal) is a strong combo.
Gravitum (gun) roots, great for setting up kills with your team.
Use Crescendum (R) for huge teamfight damage with rapid-fire shots.
Manage ammo carefully - swapping weapons too often wastes resources.

champions.name: Ashe
tips: Use Hawkshot (E) regularly for vision and to scout enemy jungler/rotations.
Enchanted Crystal Arrow (R) has huge range - use it to set up global plays.
Volley (W) applies your passive crit slow to all targets hit.
Frost Shot (passive) slows on auto-attacks, great for kiting.

champions.name: Aurelion Sol
tips: Build stardust by hitting champions with Q to increase your star size and damage.
Use W (Celestial Voyage) to roam quickly across the map.
Comet of Legend (R) can be used offensively to engage or defensively to escape.
Position your stars to zone enemies away from objectives.

champions.name: Aurora
tips: Use The Weirding (E) to dash through walls and reposition in fights.
Stack passive stacks on enemies before going for an all-in.
Between Worlds (R) grants a shield and bonus movement speed - use it to engage or disengage.
Q (The Hex) can be cast twice in quick succession for follow-up damage.

champions.name: Azir
tips: Use soldiers to shield allies in fights with Arise! (Q).
Shurima's Legacy (E) lets you teleport to your soldiers - use it to dodge skillshots.
Conquering Sands (R) can wall off enemies or push them into your team.
Stay behind your soldiers to maximize range and safety.

champions.name: Bard
tips: Collect Meeps (chimes) for movement speed and ability power stacking.
Use Tempered Fate (R) to stop objectives like Baron/Dragon or to save allies.
Magical Journey (E) creates shortcuts through walls for your team.
Caretaker's Shrines heal allies and grant movement speed - place them strategically.

champions.name: Bel'Veth
tips: Void Surge (W) dashes give bonus attack speed - chain them in fights.
Use R (Endless Banquet) to instantly clear waves and dive towers.
Above and Beyond (E) lets you dash across the map, use it to gank or escape.
True damage stacks from passive scale with attack speed - prioritize AS items.

champions.name: Blitzcrank
tips: Land Rocket Grab (Q) to instantly turn fights - aim for isolated targets.
Use Power Fist (E) to amplify your grab follow-up damage.
Static Field (R) silences on activation, great for shutting down enchanters/casters.
Manaflow Band/W passive shield helps you survive trades after grabbing.

champions.name: Brand
tips: Chain abilities to apply Blaze stacks - a third ability application detonates for bonus damage.
Pillar of Flame (Q) deals more damage to ablazed targets.
Pyroclasm (R) bounces between targets - aim it through groups for max bounces.
Conflagration (E) spreads Blaze to nearby enemies.

champions.name: Braum
tips: Stack Concussive Blows (passive) with autos and Winter's Bite (Q) to stun.
Unbreakable (W) blocks projectiles for your team - position it to protect carries.
Glacial Fissure (R) knocks up and slows enemies in a line.
Stand In Front of Me (E) lets you body-block for an ally.

champions.name: Briar
tips: Activate Blood Frenzy (passive) before fights for bonus attack speed and healing.
Use Chilling Scream (E) to root enemies, ideal for setting up your jungler ganks.
Head Rush (R) makes you immune to crowd control while charging.
Be careful with Hemoplague-like uncontrollable rage; disengage timing matters.

champions.name: Caitlyn
tips: Place Yordle Snap Traps (W) in bushes and common pathing spots for vision and CC.
Use 90 Caliber Net (E) to peel or finish off fleeing enemies, jump backward with it.
Piltover Peacemaker (Q) deals bonus damage if it travels far enough.
Ace in the Hole (R) is a long-range execute - combo with traps for guaranteed hits.

champions.name: Camille
tips: Use Hookshot (E) onto walls to engage from unexpected angles.
Your ultimate (R) traps a single target, isolating them from their team.
Adaptive Defenses (passive) shields against the next instance of damage type after using an ability.
Precision Protocol (Q) true damage finishes execute targets.

champions.name: Cassiopeia
tips: Apply Noxious Blast (Q) before other abilities to reduce their cooldowns via passive.
Avoid moving in a straight line - your passive removes boots, but movement matters for dodging.
Petrifying Gaze (R) only stuns if enemies are facing you.
Twin Fang (E) deals more damage and refunds mana on poisoned targets.

champions.name: Cho'Gath
tips: Stack Feast (R) on minions/champions to permanently grow in size and stats.
Rupture (Q) silences if it knocks up - use it to cancel channels.
Vorpal Spikes (W) passive applies on autos; weave in autos for poke.
Carnivore (passive) heals/restores mana on champion takedowns.

champions.name: Corki
tips: Phosphorus Bomb (Q) reveals stealthed units and deals true damage to structures.
Valkyrie (E) can be used to dodge skillshots or escape ganks.
Missile Barrage (R) stacks up over time - use the empowered shots wisely.
Build a mix of AD and AP since Corki scales with both.

champions.name: Darius
tips: Stack Hemorrhage (passive) to 5 stacks for the execute on Noxian Guillotine (R).
Apprehend (E) pulls enemies in and grants armor pen - use it to start trades.
Decimate (Q) heals you based on enemies hit, position to hit multiple targets.
R resets cooldown on takedowns - chain kills in teamfights.

champions.name: Diana
tips: Moonfall (E) pulls enemies toward you, combo with Q for burst.
Pale Cascade (W) shield absorbs damage and detonates for AoE.
Lunar Rush (R) resets on champion takedowns - chain through low-HP enemies.
Crescent Strike (Q) reveals enemies hit for a few seconds.

champions.name: Dr. Mundo
tips: Maximum Dosage (R) heals a percentage of max HP and grants resistances.
Throw your bonus health into Heart Zapper (E) - it scales off max HP.
Adrenaline Rush (passive) regenerates HP based on missing health.
Use Blunt Force Trauma (Q) cleavers to slow and harass from range.

champions.name: Draven
tips: Catch Spinning Axes (passive) to maintain bonus AD - practice your timing.
Stand Aside (E) knocks back and slows, good for peeling or finishing.
Whirling Death (R) axes deal more damage if caught and re-thrown.
Adoration stacks (passive gold) require last-hitting, not just damaging.

champions.name: Ekko
tips: Chronobreak (R) heals based on damage dealt during the rewind window - go aggressive before using it.
Parallel Convergence (E) zone stuns enemies on second hit - delay the cast for max value.
Z-Drive Resonance (passive) detonates for bonus damage and slow on third hit.
Use Phase Dive (W) to gap close and gain a shield.

champions.name: Elise
tips: Switch to Spider Form for burst combos, switch back to Human Form to escape with Cocoon (E).
Rappel (E in spider form) lets you jump to a champion and gain bonus AD next attack.
Spiderlings (passive) deal extra damage to low HP targets - great for executes.
Use Human Form Cocoon to stun from range before engaging.

champions.name: Evelynn
tips: Stay in stealth (passive) until level 6 to avoid ganks and set up ambushes.
Hate Spike (Q) charges deal more damage - charge them up before engaging.
Last Caress (R) execute damage is doubled against low-HP enemies.
Use Whiplash (W) to slow and reposition during your combo.

champions.name: Ezreal
tips: Mystic Shot (Q) resets auto-attack timer and reduces cooldowns on hit.
Arcane Shift (E) is a blink - use it to dodge skillshots or reposition.
Trueshot Barrage (R) is global range, use it to secure kills across the map.
Essence Flux (W) buffs your next attack/spell with bonus magic damage.

champions.name: Fiddlesticks
tips: Use Bountiful Harvest (W) on cooldown to fear and drain HP from enemies.
Crowstorm (R) can be cast from stealth for a surprise teamfight engage.
Terrify (Q) fears in a small AoE - great for peeling or initiating chaos.
Reap (E) heals you and slows enemies hit.

champions.name: Fiora
tips: Hit Vitals (passive) for bonus true damage and healing - they appear on enemy champions periodically.
Bladework (W) empowers your next two autos; combo with vitals for max damage.
Riposte (E) parries crowd control and damage, use it defensively against engages.
Grand Challenge (R) reveals all 4 vitals and heals your team if you finish the duel.

champions.name: Fizz
tips: Playful/Trickster (E) makes you untargetable briefly - use it to dodge ultimates.
Urchin Strike (Q) dashes through units, good for engaging or escaping.
Chum the Waters (R) fish deals more damage closer to the impact center.
Seastone Trident (W) passive applies on-hit magic damage and healing.

champions.name: Galio
tips: Hero's Entrance (R) taunts enemies near your landing spot - aim for clustered targets.
Wind Wall (passive shield from Righteous Gust) blocks projectiles when triggered.
Use Justice Punch (Q) to engage and knock back into your team.
Idol of Durand (W) taunts nearby enemies and shields you.

champions.name: Gangplank
tips: Place Powder Kegs (W) in jungle camps and lanes, detonate with Q for big damage.
Parrrley (Q) applies a stacking passive that deals damage over time.
Cannon Barrage (R) zones large areas and slows - great for split push defense or teamfight setup.
Remove crowd control and heal with Cure (E).

champions.name: Garen
tips: Judgement (E) deals more damage the longer you spin - try not to interrupt it.
Decisive Strike (Q) silences on hit, use it to interrupt channels/ultimates.
Demacian Justice (R) execute scales with target's missing HP - great for finishing low-HP enemies.
Perseverance (passive) regenerates HP rapidly out of combat.

champions.name: Gnar
tips: Manage your Rage meter (passive) - transform into Mega Gnar at the right time for fights.
Mega Gnar's W (GNAR!) knocks back and stuns on wall collision.
Hyper (E in mini form) leaps over walls and slows.
Boulder Toss (Q) as Mega Gnar knocks up enemies in a line.

champions.name: Gragas
tips: Body Slam (E) knocks up and resets cooldown on takedown.
Explosive Cask (R) can knock enemies into your team or away from objectives.
Drunken Rage (W) reduces incoming damage and boosts next ability.
Use Barrel Roll (Q) to zone enemies from objectives with the slow.

champions.name: Graves
tips: End of the Line (Q) explodes on collision with terrain - aim near walls for max damage.
Smoke Screen (R) blinds enemies and reduces vision - use it to disengage or set up picks.
Quickdraw (E) reloads a charge of Q on hit.
True Grit (passive) grants armor/MR for standing still - useful when sieging.

champions.name: Gwen
tips: Cast Skip 'n Slash (E) inside your Hallowed Mist (W) for bonus attack speed and a dash.
Snip Snip! (Q) deals more damage the closer enemies are.
Stand in your mist (W) to gain a defensive buff against ranged attacks.
Needlework (R) shreds and slows multiple targets in a cone.

champions.name: Hecarim
tips: Devastating Charge (E) builds momentum the longer you move forward without turning.
Onslaught of Shadows (R) fears enemies in a line, great for splitting up enemy teams.
Spirit of Dread (W) heals you based on damage dealt to nearby enemies.
Use Rampage (Q) bonus from passive to clear jungle camps quickly.

champions.name: Heimerdinger
tips: Place H-28G Turrets (Q) in bushes and chokepoints for vision and zone control.
Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) deal bonus damage to low-HP and CC'd enemies.
CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) stuns if it lands on champions hit by your other abilities.
Upgrade!!! (R) - use the right upgrade for the situation: rockets for poke, grenade for CC, turret for damage.

champions.name: Hwei
tips: Combine spell combos for bonus effects (e.g., Devastating Fire + Severing Bolt).
Use Subject: Disaster (W) for AoE fear and burst damage.
Spiraling Despair (R) roots enemies caught in the convergence point - aim for chokepoints.
Practice your combo order to maximize CC chains.

champions.name: Illaoi
tips: Land Tentacle Smash (Q) on tentacles for extra slams.
Test of Spirit (E) pulls out an enemy's spirit - hitting it deals true damage and heals you.
Leap of Faith (R) summons many tentacles - aim for objectives or teamfights.
Harsh Lesson (passive) heals you from tentacle damage on champions.

champions.name: Irelia
tips: Bladesurge (Q) resets on kill - chain through minions to reach champions.
Flawless Duet (E) stuns if both blades hit the same target.
Vanguard's Edge (R) marks enemies hit, detonating for bonus damage when they take more damage.
Defiant Dance (W) reduces incoming damage from the marked direction.

champions.name: Ivern
tips: Brushmaker (passive) creates brush - use it to set up vision and ganks.
Daisy! (R) is a powerful pet - use her in objective fights.
Triggerseed (E) shields allies and roots enemies on cast.
Root and Bark grants you camps for free - clear smartly to maximize allied jungler farm.

champions.name: Janna
tips: Monsoon (R) can heal/shield allies and knock back enemies - use it for huge teamfight swings.
Zephyr (W) passive grants movement speed - kite while autoattacking.
Howling Gale (Q) charge longer for more knockup/damage.
Eye of the Storm (E) shield + AD buff is great proactive peel.

champions.name: Jarvan IV
tips: Combo Demacian Standard (E) + Dragon Strike (Q) to create a wall and deal bonus damage.
Cataclysm (R) creates an arena, isolating a target - great for 1v1s and picks.
Golden Aegis (W) shields you and slows enemies around you.
Use the EQ flash for surprise engages.

champions.name: Jax
tips: Counter Strike (E) dodges all attacks briefly and stuns on activation.
Stack Relentless Assault (passive) by autoattacking for bonus attack speed.
Grandmaster's Might (R) gives armor/MR boost and empowers next attack.
Leap Strike (Q) lets you jump to allies, enemies, or minions to engage/escape.

champions.name: Jayce
tips: Switch between Hammer (melee) and Cannon (ranged) forms based on the situation.
Shock Blast (Q in cannon form) detonates Acceleration Gate (E) for bonus damage and speed.
To-The-Skies! (R in hammer form) knocks up enemies, great for engages.
Use cannon form to poke from range, switch to hammer form to finish in melee.

champions.name: Jhin
tips: Your 4th auto-attack (passive) is always a guaranteed crit with bonus range.
Curtain Call (R) can execute low-HP enemies from extreme range.
Deadly Flourish (E) roots if the target was recently hit by you or an ally.
Whisper (W) traps deal more damage and reveal enemies in a cone.

champions.name: Jinx
tips: Get Excited! (passive) grants attack speed and movement speed after takedowns - chain kills.
Switch to rockets (W) for AoE poke and structure damage.
Flame Chompers! (E) root enemies who walk over them - place them to block chokepoints.
Super Mega Death Rocket! (R) deals more damage the farther it travels.

champions.name: K'Sante
tips: Build up Ntofo stacks (passive) with abilities for bonus damage on next auto.
All Out (R) transforms your kit - use it to engage with Path Maker (E) for a long knock-up.
Override (E) can knock enemies into walls for a stun.
Ability shred from passive lowers enemy resistances over time.

champions.name: Kai'Sa
tips: Stack Plasma (passive) with abilities, then auto-attack to deal bonus magic damage.
Killer Instinct (R) lets you dash to nearby enemies who are below 50% HP - use it to dive backline.
Void Seeker (Q) marks enemies, increasing plasma stacking.
Supercharge (E) grants attack speed and movement speed - activate before fights.

champions.name: Kalista
tips: Rend (passive) - spears stack on enemies; recast Q to detonate them for bonus damage.
Sentinel bond with support lets you both pull each other - use Fate's Call (E) wisely.
Martial Poise (passive) lets you hop after every attack - use this to kite while attacking.
Coordinate Black Spear (R) with allies for a guaranteed root chain.

champions.name: Karma
tips: Mantra (R) empowers your next ability - use empowered Inspire (W) for big shields/speed.
Empowered Soul Flare (E) roots enemies who stay in the zone too long.
Empowered Heavenly Wave (Q) deals bonus damage and slows in a line.
Use Mantra shield proactively to enable allies to all-in.

champions.name: Karthus
tips: Defile (W) toggles a damaging aura - manage mana carefully.
Requiem (R) is global - use it to secure kills across the map even after death.
Wall of Pain (E) reduces enemy MR and slows those who pass through.
After death, your passive lets you cast spells for several seconds - maximize Defile uptime.

champions.name: Kassadin
tips: Riftwalk (R) cost increases with consecutive casts but resets on takedown.
Force Pulse (W) deals more damage and silences if you recently used another ability (Netherblade passive).
Null Sphere (Q) silences - use it to interrupt enemy ultimates.
Build Magic Resist early to scale into a teamfight powerhouse late game.

champions.name: Katarina
tips: Death Lotus (R) resets on takedown - chain kills across teamfights.
Shunpo (E) resets cooldown when it kills a unit, including daggers.
Throw daggers (Q) and reposition with Shunpo to chain resets.
Voracity (passive) reduces cooldowns on takedown - snowball off kills.

champions.name: Kayle
tips: Kayle becomes ranged at level 6 - play safe early and scale.
Divine Judgment (R) can save allies from death - use proactively in skirmishes.
Radiant Blast (Q) slows and marks for bonus damage from autos.
Starfire Spellblade (passive) procs deal AoE damage around the target.

champions.name: Kayn
tips: Choose your form based on enemy comp: Rhaast (tanky AoE) vs Shadow Assassin (mobile single-target).
Shadow Step (Q) lets you pass through units and walls.
Umbral Trespass (R) lets you enter a champion as Shadow Assassin to assassinate.
As Rhaast, your ultimate is a knockback - use it to peel or zone.

champions.name: Kennen
tips: Stack Mark of the Storm (passive) on enemies for a stun - 3 hits stuns.
Slicing Maelstrom (R) deals AoE damage and helps stack marks for team stuns.
Lightning Rush (E) makes you untargetable while dashing through units.
Electrical Surge (W) passive procs deal bonus magic damage on autos.

champions.name: Kha'Zix
tips: Isolated targets (no nearby units) take bonus damage from your abilities (passive).
Evolve abilities based on game plan - Void Assault (R) evolution adds a third dash.
Taste Their Fear (Q) deals bonus damage to isolated targets, great for picks.
Use Leap (E) to reposition and gain evasion after landing.

champions.name: Kindred
tips: Mark of the Kindred (passive) marks jungle camps and champions - kill marked targets for stacks.
Lamb's Respite (R) prevents death for everyone in the zone - use to win or avoid losing teamfights.
Dance Between (E) lets you dash through a unit and gain attack speed.
Stack passive on a target before engaging for max damage.

champions.name: Kled
tips: When dismounted, you become Skaarl-less Kled with reduced stats - retreat to heal up courage to remount.
Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) pulls you to the target if it hits.
Chaaaaaarge!!! (R) grants massive movement speed in a direction - use to engage or to escape.
Violent Tendencies (passive) empowers your next attack after autos - watch for the indicator.

champions.name: Kog'Maw
tips: Living Artillery (W) has long range - use it for poke and to zone enemies from objectives.
Void Ooze (E) leaves a trail that increases the range of your next Living Artillery.
Icathian Surprise (R) detonates on death dealing % max HP damage - don't be afraid to overextend slightly when low.
Bio-Arcane Barrage (passive) gives true damage on-hit at low HP enemies, great for shredding tanks.

champions.name: LeBlanc
tips: Mimic (R) replicates your last cast ability for burst combos.
Distortion (E) is a dash that you can recast to return to the original location.
Ethereal Chains (W) deals bonus damage and roots if it reapplies before expiring.
Use Sigil of Malice (Q) marks to set up your full burst combo.

champions.name: Lee Sin
tips: Combo Sonic Wave (Q) into Resonating Strike (W) for poke/follow-up damage.
Use Dragon's Rage (R) to kick enemies into walls (stun) or away from objectives/allies.
Safeguard (W on ally) shields and dashes to allies - use it proactively to protect carries.
Tempest (E) reveals enemies hit and slows after a delay.

champions.name: Leona
tips: Combo Zenith Blade (E) into Shield of Daybreak (Q) for a stun.
Solar Flare (R) stuns at the center - land it on key targets.
Sunlight (passive) marks enemies for bonus damage from allies.
Eclipse (W) shields you - activate before diving in.

champions.name: Lillia
tips: Dream-Laden Bough (Q) deals bonus damage to sleeping/slowed targets.
Watch Out! Eep! (E) slows enemies and speeds up Lillia.
Lilting Lullaby (R) puts enemies to sleep - follow up with Q for big damage.
Use W (Blooming Blows) to clear jungle camps quickly with bonus magic damage stacking.

champions.name: Lissandra
tips: Glacial Path (E) is a ghost dash - use it to scout or escape through walls.
Frozen Tomb (R) makes you untargetable - use it to bait or save yourself, also locks down a champion.
Ring of Frost (W) roots nearby enemies - useful to stop dives.
Combo Q (Ice Shard) for slows and follow up with R for guaranteed root.

champions.name: Lucian
tips: Relentless Pursuit (E) resets on champion takedowns - chain dashes for kills.
Piercing Light (Q) passive lets your next auto fire an extra shot after using an ability.
The Culling (R) deals more damage the closer enemies are.
Ardent Blaze (W) reveals and slows enemies in a line.

champions.name: Lulu
tips: Wild Growth (R) on allies grants a knockup and huge HP buff - great engage/peel tool.
Polymorph (E) on enemy carries shuts down their damage in fights.
Help, Pix! (Q) - shield allies or attack enemies, the bolt bounces to give vision.
Whimsy (W) can be used to speed up allies or slow/shrink enemies.

champions.name: Lux
tips: Light Binding (Q) roots up to two targets - aim through minions to hit champions.
Final Spark (R) deals bonus damage to targets affected by your other spells (Illumination passive).
Lucent Singularity (E) zone slows - detonate it for AoE damage.
Prismatic Barrier (W) shields allies in both directions of the throw.

champions.name: Malphite
tips: Unstoppable Force (R) is a long-range engage that knocks up everyone hit - aim for the whole enemy team.
Ground Slam (E) reduces enemy attack speed, great vs auto-attack reliant champions.
Seismic Shard (Q) slows and deals bonus damage based on enemy missing HP.
Granite Shield (passive) absorbs damage - wait for it to recharge before engaging.

champions.name: Malzahar
tips: Nether Grasp (R) is a long-duration suppress - use it on priority targets.
Malefic Visions (E) jumps to a new target on kill, dealing % max HP damage.
Null Zone (W) deals more damage the more health the target has.
Voidlings (passive) spawn from Call of the Void (Q) hits and assist in clearing/fighting.

champions.name: Maokai
tips: Sapling Toss (Q) saplings root and reveal enemies they hit.
Vengeful Maelstrom (R) deals AoE damage and provides global vision when activated.
Twisted Advance (E) roots after a chain - use it to lock down priority targets.
Sap Magic (passive) heals you when hit by enemy spells.

champions.name: Master Yi
tips: Highlander (R) grants movement speed, attack speed, and tenacity - use it to chase or escape.
Alpha Strike (Q) makes you invulnerable briefly and resets on takedown.
Double Strike (passive) procs every other auto for bonus true damage at higher levels.
Wuju Style (W) adds true damage to autos - great for melting tanks.

champions.name: Milio
tips: Cozy Campfire (R) cleanses and grants a powerful shield to allies in the zone - use to counter enemy ultimates.
Warm Hugs (W) shields and speeds up allies hit, including through Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q).
Combo Q through allies to apply Warm Hugs shields before fights.
Passive grants bonus range on abilities the lower your mana - manage mana for poke range.

champions.name: Miss Fortune
tips: Bullet Time (R) deals more damage to targets affected by your other abilities.
Make It Rain (E) slows a large area - use it to zone or set up R.
Strut (passive) grants bonus movement speed when not taking damage - great for kiting.
Double Up (Q) bounces to a target behind for double damage - position for value.

champions.name: Mordekaiser
tips: Realm of Death (R) isolates a single enemy in a 1v1 realm - great for picking off backline carries.
Death Wears Down (E) marks enemies, slowing and dealing bonus damage on second hit.
Indestructible (W) shields based on damage dealt - use it during extended trades.
Use Obliterate (Q) to last hit and deal AoE damage in melee range.

champions.name: Morgana
tips: Black Shield (E) blocks the next CC effect - use proactively before enemy engages.
Tormented Soil (W) damages enemies who stand on it, great for zoning.
Soul Shackles (R) stuns enemies who stay tethered too long - position for max value.
Dark Binding (Q) is a long-range root - lead your shots.

champions.name: Naafiri
tips: Summon a Pack (passive) creates dogs that assist in combat - use them for extra damage in fights.
Eviscerate (Q) dashes to a target - chain into combos.
Hounds' Pursuit (E) gives a shield and speed boost while dashing through units.
Pack Your Bags (R) damages and displaces enemies - great in skirmishes.

champions.name: Nami
tips: Tidal Wave (R) knocks up and slows - use it to start teamfights.
Aqua Prison (Q) is your main CC - lead your shots on priority targets.
Ebb and Flow (W) heals allies and damages enemies, bouncing between them.
Tidecaller's Blessing (E) buffs an ally with attack speed and a slow on-hit.

champions.name: Nasus
tips: Siphoning Strike (Q) stacks permanently on kills - prioritize last hits to scale your Q damage.
Fury of the Sands (R) transforms you into a powerful AoE bruiser - use in teamfights.
Wither (E) cripples a target's attack speed and movement - great vs hypercarries.
Spirit Fire (W) reduces armor - apply before all-ins.

champions.name: Nautilus
tips: Dredge Line (Q) hooks and pulls you to the target, also pulling them slightly toward you.
Depth Charge (R) homes onto your hooked target dealing knockup and damage.
Titan's Wrath (W) shields you - autoattack after casting for bonus damage.
Riptide (E) roots enemies on the second hit - position for it to hit twice.

champions.name: Neeko
tips: Disguise yourself as allies/minions (passive) to bait enemies.
Pop Blossom (R) telegraphs but deals huge AoE damage and stuns - use as a finisher.
Shapesplitter (W) creates a clone that mimics your movements - use for extra info/distraction.
Tangle-Barbs (Q) roots if it hits an already-rooted target from your E.

champions.name: Nidalee
tips: Javelin Toss (Q) deals massively more damage to low-HP targets in human form.
Use Cougar form's Pounce (E) to chase, then Takedown (Q) to execute.
Bushwhack (W) traps grant vision and reveal stealthed units.
Swipe (E in human form) heals you when hitting champions - useful for sustain.

champions.name: Nilah
tips: Jubilant Veil (R) shares a shield and lifesteal buff with all nearby allies - use in big skirmishes.
Formless Blade (Q) hits in a wide arc and grants lifesteal, scaling with allied lifesteal too.
Slipstream (E) dashes through enemies, granting movement speed for each enemy hit.
Jousting (passive) grants bonus attack range and movement speed in a tether with enemies.

champions.name: Nocturne
tips: Paranoia (R) silences your target globally and grants vision near them - use to dive backline.
Duskbringer (Q) leaves a trail granting bonus damage and movement speed when you walk through it.
Unspeakable Horror (E) fears enemies if it persists for the full duration.
Shroud of Darkness (W) blocks the next ability/auto and empowers your next attack.

champions.name: Nunu & Willump
tips: Absolute Zero (R) channel deals massive damage if completed - use Snowball Fight (W) to set up the kill.
Consume (Q) deals bonus true damage to monsters, great for fast jungle clears.
Biggest Snowball Ever! (W) grows the longer you roll - use it to engage from afar.
Smash (E) knocks up after 2 autos in melee range.

champions.name: Olaf
tips: Ragnarok (R) removes all CC and grants tenacity - use it against heavy CC teams.
Reckless Swing (Q) deals true damage based on your current HP, but damages yourself too.
Undertow (E) leaves an axe on the ground that slows when picked up again.
Berserker Rage (passive) grants attack speed scaling with missing health.

champions.name: Orianna
tips: Command: Shockwave (R) pulls enemies toward the ball - position the ball centrally before casting.
Command: Protect (W) shields an ally and moves the ball to them.
Command: Dissonance (E) ball deals damage in a zone - use to zone enemies.
Command: Attack (Q) deals bonus damage based on target's missing health.

champions.name: Ornn
tips: Forge upgraded items for yourself and teammates at the Hearthblossom anvil.
Searing Charge (R) knocks enemies into walls for a stun - aim for chokepoints.
Bellows Breath (W) buffs your next ability - combine with Q or E for bonus effects.
Volcanic Rupture (Q) creates pillars that can be used with W for a wall of fire.

champions.name: Pantheon
tips: Grand Skyfall (R) lets you choose the landing location for a global engage with a shield on landing.
Comet Spear (Q) crits against enemies hit by Shield Vault (E).
Aegis Assault (W) blocks projectiles from the front and deals AoE damage.
Use Shield Vault (E) to stun and dash to a target.

champions.name: Poppy
tips: Heroic Charge (E) slams enemies into walls for a stun - position for max value.
Steadfast Presence (W) blocks dashes through you and slows the dasher.
Keeper's Verdict (R) knocks enemies away - can hit multiple if lined up.
Hammer Shock (Q) deals bonus damage based on target's max HP.

champions.name: Pyke
tips: Death from Below (R) executes low-HP enemies and resets cooldown on kill - chain kills in teamfights.
Bone Skewer (Q) hooks and pulls enemies toward you.
Phantom Undertow (E) stuns enemies on the return trip.
Gold from kills with R goes to your team, not you - assists are key for your build.

champions.name: Qiyana
tips: Use terrain (grass, water, rock) to empower your Q with different effects (root, slow+shield, knockup).
Terrashape (R) grants bonus stats based on the last element you used.
Audacity (E) dashes to enemies you've recently damaged.
Combo elemental Q + E + R for huge burst on isolated targets.

champions.name: Quinn
tips: Behind Enemy Lines (R) grants huge movement speed and turns autos into AoE - use to roam or chase.
Vault (E) blinds and roots after a brief delay - use to disengage from melee.
Harrier (passive) marks targets via Valor - attack marked targets for bonus damage.
Use Valor's scouting to gain vision of enemy jungler/flanks.

champions.name: Rakan
tips: Combo Grand Entrance (R) for a knockup, then Gleaming Quill (Q) to root for a kill.
Battle Dance (E) shields you and dashes to an ally - use to peel or all-in together.
The Quickness (W) grants speed and shields - activate before engaging.
Use W cooldown reduction from hitting enemies to chain abilities faster.

champions.name: Rammus
tips: Defensive Ball Curl (E) massively boosts armor/MR and adds damage to autos - activate before fights.
Tremors (R) deals AoE damage around you, great when surrounded.
Powerball (Q) lets you roll to engage and stuns on impact.
Build full tank - your damage scales with bonus armor/MR.

champions.name: Rek'Sai
tips: Burrow (R toggle) to travel underground quickly and create tunnels for fast rotations.
Unburrow near isolated targets to knock them up with Un-burrow (R).
Tunnels can be used by your team too for fast map traversal.
Furious Bite (Q) deals bonus damage if the target is below 50% HP.

champions.name: Rell
tips: Ferromancy: Crash Down (R) dismounts you for a knockup - mount up again to remount with healing.
Attract and Repel (W) pulls enemies toward you (mounted) or pushes them away (dismounted).
Mounted form gives mobility, dismounted gives tankiness and CC.
Use Mount Up (R while dismounted) to disengage or reposition during fights.

champions.name: Renata Glasc
tips: Berserk (R) can turn an enemy against their team - cast it on a key threat during a fight.
Bailout (E) revives an ally as a temporary buff if they would die after using it.
Handshake! (Q) chains enemies together, dragging one toward the other.
Loyalty Program (W) shields and grants attack speed/movement speed to allies.

champions.name: Renekton
tips: Manage Fury (passive) by autoattacking and using abilities; spend it on empowered Q/E/W.
Empowered Slice and Dice (E) heals you, useful for sustained trades.
Dominus (R) grants bonus HP and Fury regen - use during extended fights.
Empowered Cull the Meek (W) heals based on damage dealt to multiple enemies.

champions.name: Rengar
tips: Ambush (Q) from brush deals bonus damage and grants empowered abilities (Bonetooth Necklace passive).
Bola Strike (E) roots if thrown from brush/stealth.
Thrill of the Hunt (R) grants stealth and reveals the lowest HP enemy nearby - use to pick off carries.
Save empowered Bola (root) for engaging onto priority targets.

champions.name: Riven
tips: Combo Broken Wings (Q) charges with Valor (E) dash for extended mobility and damage.
Wind Slash (R) deals more damage to low-HP enemies and can be cast through walls if you have charges.
Ki Burst (W) stuns nearby enemies - use it to interrupt or follow up combos.
Runic Blade (passive) empowers your next auto after using an ability - weave autos into your combo.

champions.name: Rumble
tips: Manage your Heat gauge (passive) - overheating disables abilities temporarily.
The Equalizer (R) deals more damage at the edges - aim it to box enemies into the danger zone center.
Flamespitter (Q) deals more damage to low-HP targets at high heat.
Electro-Harpoon (E) slows and applies bonus damage from Q/W.

champions.name: Ryze
tips: Chain Realm Warp (R) with allies for surprise team engages.
Spell Flux (E) reduces enemy MR and applies your passive rune mark.
Overload (Q) refunds cooldown when cast on a marked target (from E or W).
Build mostly AP/mana items - Ryze scales heavily with mana.

champions.name: Samira
tips: Build Style points (passive) by using varied abilities/attacks without repeating - unlocks Inferno Trigger (R).
Wild Rush (E) dashes to an ally or through an enemy, resetting on takedown.
Blade Whirl (W) blocks projectiles and deals damage to nearby enemies.
Combo into knocked-up/airborne enemies for guaranteed damage with Q.

champions.name: Sejuani
tips: Glacial Prison (R) stuns a long line of enemies - aim through chokepoints in teamfights.
Permafrost (passive) stuns enemies who are already slowed and hit by your abilities.
Winter's Wrath (E) applies a guaranteed stun if the enemy was already slowed.
Build tank items and engage for your team - your CC chains are extremely valuable.

champions.name: Senna
tips: Last Embrace (Q) deals bonus damage and roots if it hits an enemy in fog of war/brush.
Collect Mist from minion deaths near you (passive) for permanent AD/AP/range.
Dawning Shadow (R) heals allies and damages enemies along a long line.
Curse of the Black Mist (W) grants stealth in brush/fog for you and nearby allies.

champions.name: Seraphine
tips: Abilities cost extra mana but echo a second cast for free if you have allies nearby (passive).
Encore (R) stuns/charms enemies already affected by CC.
Surround Sound (W) shields allies and grants bonus range.
High Note (passive) procs deal bonus magic damage on autos.

champions.name: Sett
tips: The Show Stopper (R) deals more damage based on your max HP - build HP for bigger ults.
Grit (passive) builds a shield as you take/deal damage - haymaker (next empowered auto) when full.
Facebreaker (E) hits twice if there are enemies on both sides of you.
Pick Apart Their Armor (W) grants bonus damage based on target's max HP.

champions.name: Shaco
tips: Hallucinate (R) creates a clone to bait enemies - swap places defensively.
Two-Shiv Poison (Q) deals bonus damage to low-HP enemies and applies a slow.
Jack In The Box (W) hidden in brush fears enemies who walk near it.
Backstab (passive) deals bonus damage when attacking from behind.

champions.name: Shen
tips: Stand United (R) shields and teleports you to an ally anywhere on the map - use to save teammates in danger.
Spirit's Refuge (E) blocks incoming damage in an area - use to protect allies from burst.
Shadow Dash (W) taunts enemies hit at the end of the dash.
Twilight Assault (Q) marks the enemy with lowest HP% - prioritize hitting them.

champions.name: Shyvana
tips: Dragon's Descent (R) transforms you and lets you leap into a fight, dealing AoE damage.
Twin Bite (Q) deals bonus magic damage on the second hit and heals while in dragon form.
Burnout (E) deals more damage and grants more movement speed in dragon form.
Use Flame Breath (W) to mark targets for bonus damage.

champions.name: Singed
tips: Insanity Potion (R) buffs all your stats - drink it before extended fights/chases.
Fling (E) throws enemies behind you - use it to fling carries into your team or away from theirs.
Poison Trail (W) deals damage over time - run through enemies to apply it.
Use Mega Adhesive (Q) to slow chasers or zone enemies from objectives.

champions.name: Sion
tips: Glory in Death (passive) lets you move and detonate for damage after dying - use it for one last engage/escape.
Unstoppable Onslaught (R) charges further the longer you channel - use from max range for huge knockups.
Soul Furnace (W) shield detonates for AoE damage - time it well.
Decimating Smash (Q) deals bonus damage to structures when fully charged.

champions.name: Sivir
tips: Spell Shield (E) blocks a single enemy spell - use it to negate enemy engages or burst.
On the Hunt (R) grants your team bonus movement speed - use for chases or rotations.
Boomerang Blade (Q) hits twice on the return - position to hit on both passes.
Ricochet (W) bounces between enemies, great for wave clear.

champions.name: Skarner
tips: Impale (R) drags an enemy with you while you have crystal spires for bonus effects.
Crystal Spires give vision and bonuses when controlled - prioritize objectives near them.
Fracture (E) slows and damages in a line - chain into Impale for engages.
Shattered Earth (passive) marks enemies for bonus damage on subsequent hits.

champions.name: Smolder
tips: Stack passive (Dragon Practice) by last-hitting with Q early to scale your fire breath.
Achooo! (R) sneeze deals more damage based on stacks - save for big fights once stacked.
Flap, Flap, Flap (E) grants a shield and movement speed - use to dodge skillshots.
Super Sneeze stacks build from takedowns and minion kills with Q - prioritize farming.

champions.name: Sona
tips: Crescendo (R) stuns all enemies hit in a line - great for starting teamfights.
Power Chord (passive) procs every 3rd ability cast - weave abilities for extra damage/utility.
Switch songs (Q/W/E) based on what your team needs - aura plus power chord effect.
Use Song of Celerity (E) to help allies escape or chase.

champions.name: Soraka
tips: Wish (R) heals your whole team globally - use it during teamfights for huge sustain.
Equinox (E) silences and roots enemies who stay in the zone too long.
Starcall (Q) heals you when it hits an enemy.
Astral Infusion (W) heals an ally at the cost of your own HP - manage your health pool.

champions.name: Swain
tips: Demonic Ascension (R) heals you based on damage dealt by you and nearby allies in the AoE.
Vision of Empire (W) reveals a huge area and deals damage - use for global vision/poke.
Death's Hand (Q) deals bonus damage to the target if multiple bolts hit.
Nevermove (E) roots after a delay - use to set up ultimates.

champions.name: Sylas
tips: Hijack (R) steals an enemy ultimate - prioritize stealing impactful ultimates.
Petricite Burst (Q) deals more damage with more chains around you (from E).
Abscond/Abduct (E) - first cast dashes, second cast pulls enemies to you.
Kingslayer (W) heals more against low-HP targets - use to finish kills.

champions.name: Syndra
tips: Unleashed Power (R) deals more damage with more spheres - collect spheres from Q/W before ulting.
Scatter the Weak (E) knocks back spheres and enemies - combo with R for stuns.
Force of Will (W) picks up and throws spheres for burst damage.
Dark Sphere (Q) creates permanent spheres on kill - farm safely to build up spheres.

champions.name: Tahm Kench
tips: Devour (R/W) can save an ally from death by eating them - use proactively when they're in danger.
An Acquired Taste (passive) stacks on enemies hit, grant bonus damage when devouring them.
Abyssal Voyage (R) carries an ally to a target location - great for surprise plays.
Tongue Lash (Q) slows and deals bonus damage to stacked targets.

champions.name: Taliyah
tips: Weaver's Wall (W) lets you traverse terrain quickly - use for ganks and rotations.
Unraveled Earth (E) detonates when enemies move on it, knocking them up.
Threaded Volley (Q) deals more damage the more rocks you've collected.
Seismic Shove (R) knocks enemies away in a line - chain CC with allies.

champions.name: Talon
tips: Shadow Assault (R) makes you untargetable and reveals enemies hit by the blades.
Rake (E) deals more damage on the way back - position to hit twice.
Cutthroat (Q) resets cooldown on takedown - chain kills on squishies.
Use walls with W (Noxian Diplomacy passive synergy) to gap close unexpectedly.

champions.name: Taric
tips: Cosmic Radiance (R) grants invulnerability after a delay - time it for key fight moments.
Bastion (E) links you to an ally, sharing armor and your abilities' effects.
Dazzle (Q) stuns after a delay - bait enemies into position first.
Starlight's Touch (W) heals and reduces ability cooldowns based on autoattacks landed.

champions.name: Teemo
tips: Place Noxious Traps (R) in brush, jungle paths, and chokepoints for vision denial and zone control.
Blinding Dart (Q) blinds, neutralizing auto-attack reliant enemies.
Camouflage (passive) grants stealth out of combat - use for ambushes.
Toxic Shot (W) poison stacks deal damage over time on autos.

champions.name: Thresh
tips: Death Sentence (Q) hooks and pulls enemies to you - lead your shots.
Collect souls with passive for bonus armor/AP and lantern shield strength.
The Box (R) walls deal damage and slow when broken - use to trap enemies.
Dark Passage (E) lantern can save allies by pulling them to you.

champions.name: Tristana
tips: Buster Shot (E) knocks enemies back - use to peel or set up kills near walls.
Rocket Jump (W) resets cooldown on takedown and deals AoE damage on landing.
Draw a Bead (passive) grants bonus range as you level up.
Buster Shot (R upgrade) can knock enemies into your turrets/team.

champions.name: Trundle
tips: Subjugate (R) steals stats from the enemy - use it on tanks to swing fights.
Pillar of Ice (E) blocks paths and slows - use to split enemy teams or block jungle paths.
Chomp (Q) heals you and shreds armor when biting champions.
Use Pillar to secure objectives by blocking enemy access.

champions.name: Tryndamere
tips: Undying Rage (R) prevents death - use it to survive burst and turn fights around.
Spinning Slash (E) resets cooldown on kill and crits based on Fury.
Build Fury (passive) through autos/crits to fuel Bloodlust (Q) healing.
Mocking Shout (W) slows enemies and reduces their attack damage.

champions.name: Twisted Fate
tips: Destiny (R) reveals all enemy champions and enables Gate (teleport) - use for global presence.
Pick a Card (Q) - Blue card for mana, Red card for damage+slow, Gold card for stun.
Wild Cards (W) deal damage in three directions - good for poke/wave clear.
Stacked Deck (passive) empowers autos every few hits for bonus damage and attack speed.

champions.name: Twitch
tips: Ambush (passive) grants stealth out of combat - use it to flank or set up ambushes.
Spray and Pray (R) gives your autos bonus range and makes them pierce - line up enemies.
Contaminate (E) detonates Deadly Venom stacks for bonus damage - stack poison before detonating.
Use stealth to sneak into position before teamfights start.

champions.name: Udyr
tips: Switch stances based on the situation: Phoenix for AoE damage, Bear for CC, Tiger for single-target burst, Turtle for sustain.
Wingborne Storm (R Phoenix) deals AoE around you - good for clearing/teamfights.
Stance switching grants bonus effects (Awakened stances) - chain stances strategically.
Bear stance stuns on the third consecutive hit.

champions.name: Urgot
tips: Fear Beyond Death (R) executes and fears nearby enemies if it kills the target.
Disdain (E) shields and dashes through the target, flipping them behind you.
Corrosive Charge (Q) deals more damage and slows more on the second hit.
Use Purge (W) to kite while dealing sustained damage.

champions.name: Varus
tips: Chain of Corruption (R) roots enemies who are afflicted with Blight stacks longer.
Stack Living Vengeance (passive)/Blight stacks via Q and W for bonus magic damage.
Hail of Arrows (E) deals more damage to enemies at the edge of the impact zone.
Charge Piercing Arrow (Q) for more damage and range against grouped enemies.

champions.name: Vayne
tips: Final Hour (R) grants stealth, attack speed, and turns Tumble into a movement speed steroid.
Silver Bolts (passive) deal true damage every 3rd hit, percent of max HP - great vs tanks.
Condemn (E) knocks back and stuns if the target hits a wall.
Use Tumble (Q) to dodge skillshots and reposition while attacking.

champions.name: Veigar
tips: Primordial Burst (R) deals more damage to low-HP enemies - use to execute.
Phenomenal Evil Power (passive) stacks AP permanently on champion takedowns.
Event Horizon (E) stuns enemies who cross the edges of the cage - flash inside to trap them.
Dark Matter (W) telegraphs but deals heavy damage - lead your shots.

champions.name: Vel'Koz
tips: Lifeform Disintegration Ray (R) deals more damage the longer it channels on the same target.
Tectonic Disruption (E) knocks up if the target was hit by another ability first.
Void Rift (W) detonates after a delay for bonus damage to marked targets.
Plasma Fission (Q) splits on recast - use to hit multiple targets.

champions.name: Vex
tips: Gloomy/Doom (R) deals bonus true damage to dashing enemies - punish mobile champions.
Mistral Bolt (E) shields you and refreshes when an enemy you've hit dashes.
Personal Space (W) deals more damage and grants a shield based on enemy proximity.
Looming Darkness (Q) deals bonus damage to feared/marked enemies.

champions.name: Vi
tips: Cease and Desist (R) dashes to and knocks up the target - punch through other enemies first if possible.
Denting Blows (passive) shreds armor and deals bonus damage on every 3rd hit.
Vault Breaker (Q) charge longer for more range and damage.
Excessive Force (E) deals bonus damage based on target's missing health.

champions.name: Viego
tips: Possession (passive) lets you take over killed enemy champions - use this to infiltrate enemy team.
Spectral Maw (E) stuns enemies who are already affected by CC.
Heartbreaker (Q) deals more damage to enemies behind your target.
Harrowed Path (R) makes you untargetable while dashing - use to engage safely.

champions.name: Viktor
tips: Upgrade abilities via Hex Core - prioritize based on your build (e.g., Gravity Field for engage).
Chaos Storm (R) follows you and deals damage in an expanding radius.
Death Ray (E) deals bonus damage to enemies marked by Glorious Evolution stacks.
Gravity Field (W) roots enemies who stay in it too long - use to zone.

champions.name: Vladimir
tips: Sanguine Pool (E) makes you untargetable and heals based on enemies hit - use to dodge skillshots.
Hemoplague (R) increases damage taken by affected enemies - use it before your team's burst.
Transfusion (Q) heals you, alternating between empowered casts.
Use your own HP via Tides of Blood (W) to deal bonus damage - manage your health pool.

champions.name: Volibear
tips: Stormbringer (R) makes you unstoppable while charging and deals bonus true damage on landing.
Thundering Smash (Q) deals more damage and stuns when used on structures or jumping from terrain.
Frenzy (passive) grants bonus attack speed and lifesteal after using an ability.
Sky Splitter (E) marks enemies for bonus lightning damage.

champions.name: Warwick
tips: Infinite Duress (R) suppresses and heals you based on target's max HP - great for picks.
Jaws of the Beast (Q) heals more against low-HP enemies.
Blood Hunt (passive) reveals and speeds you toward low-HP enemies - use to finish kills across the map.
Primal Howl (E) shields and fears nearby enemies.

champions.name: Wukong
tips: Cyclone (R) grants armor/MR and knocks up enemies around you repeatedly.
Nimbus Strike (E) dashes to a target, hitting nearby enemies too - good for engaging multiple targets.
Decoy (W) creates a clone and grants stealth - use to dodge ultimates or fake out enemies.
Crushing Blow (Q) reduces target's armor temporarily.

champions.name: Xayah
tips: Recall feathers with Bladecaller (Q) to root enemies standing on 3+ feathers.
Featherstorm (R) makes you untargetable - use to dodge ultimates and reposition.
Deadly Plumage (W) feathers can be picked up later for the root combo.
Coordinate with Rakan for double-CC engages.

champions.name: Xerath
tips: Rite of the Arcane (R) has massive range - use it to poke from extreme safety.
Arcanopulse (Q) deals bonus damage when fully charged.
Eye of Destruction (E) stuns enemies caught in the center of the explosion.
Shocking Orb (W) deals more damage at max range.

champions.name: Xin Zhao
tips: Three Talon Strike (Q) on the third hit knocks the target up.
Crescent Sweep (R) knocks back nearby enemies and grants bonus stats - use to peel for carries.
Audacious Charge (E) slows enemies around your target on arrival.
Determination (passive) heals you - chain Q resets to sustain through fights.

champions.name: Yasuo
tips: Last Breath (R) targets airborne enemies - combo with allies' knockups for team engages.
Sweeping Blade (E) resets cooldown when it kills a unit.
Steel Tempest (Q) third hit knocks up - use it to set up your own ultimate.
Wind Wall (W) blocks enemy projectiles - use it to block ultimates like Caitlyn R or Ashe R.

champions.name: Yone
tips: Fate Sealed (R) pulls in airborne enemies - combo with your own Q3 knockup.
Spirit Cleave (E) hits in spirit form (your shield's reach) - position for max hits.
Mortal Steel (Q) third cast knocks up enemies in a line.
Soul Unbound (W) lets you dash forward as a spirit, leaving your body behind.

champions.name: Yorick
tips: Maiden of the Mist (R) summons a strong AI ally - use her to split push or in fights.
Mourning Mist (E) marks enemies, spawning a ghoul on hit if it stacks twice.
Last Rites (Q) marks minions/monsters - killing them spawns ghouls.
Use ghouls to push side lanes while you group with your team.

champions.name: Yuumi
tips: Attach to allies (passive) to become untargetable and grant them buffs.
Final Chapter (R) roots enemies caught in the line - use it to peel or pick.
You Are Not Alone (W) attaches to allies, granting heal/shield over time.
Detach to use Prowling Projectile (Q) for poke when safe.

champions.name: Zac
tips: Elastic Slingshot (E) charge longer for more range and damage, knocks up on landing.
Cell Division (passive) splits into blobs on death - reform them for a partial revive.
Let's Bounce! (R) knocks up all nearby enemies multiple times - great teamfight initiation.
Pick up your own blobs (from passive split) to heal.

champions.name: Zed
tips: Death Mark (R) deals bonus damage based on damage dealt during the mark duration - combo before ulting.
Living Shadow (W) lets you swap places with your shadow - use defensively or offensively.
Shadow Slash (E) applies your shadow's slash too if a shadow is nearby.
Use shadows to dodge skillshots by swapping at the last second.

champions.name: Zeri
tips: Spark Surge (E) over terrain grants bonus range and a burst of speed.
Lightning Crash (R) attacks chain to nearby enemies - position to hit multiple.
Living Battery (passive) charges your E by autoattacking.
Burst Fire (Q) bounces off terrain for extra damage.

champions.name: Ziggs
tips: Mega Inferno Bomb (R) deals more damage to structures - use to destroy turrets/inhibitors fast.
Satchel Charge (E) can knock enemies into your team or used to escape/jump walls.
Hexplosive Minefield (W) zones areas - use to deny jungle paths or objectives.
Short Fuse (Q) - hold it longer for more range.

champions.name: Zilean
tips: Chrono Shift (R) on allies revives them if they would die - use proactively before fights.
Time Bomb (Q) double-stack on the same target for double damage and stun.
Rewind (W) lowers your other ability cooldowns - use it often.
Time Warp (E) speeds up allies and slows enemies - great for chases/escapes.

champions.name: Zoe
tips: Sleepy Trouble Bubble (W) sleeping targets take bonus damage from your next attack.
Portal Jump (E) lets you reposition and grants a free spell pickup along the way.
Paddle Star! (R) spell can be picked up from enemy summoner spells/items dropped on death (passive).
Use Spell Thief passive to gain a free copy of enemy summoner spells.

champions.name: Zyra
tips: Stranglethorns (R) roots and damages enemies, also empowering nearby plants.
Place plants with Q/E near brush and objectives for vision and zone control.
Grasping Roots (E) roots if it travels far enough before hitting.
Rampant Growth (passive) grants extra plant seeds over time - place them in key spots.

champions.name: Mel
tips: Reflect incoming damage and crowd control with your defensive ability - use it against burst combos.
Focus enemy team's frontline to build resources for your ultimate's execute potential.
Use your ranged poke to wear down enemies before all-in.
Position carefully - your kit rewards reactive play over proactive engages.

champions.name: Ambessa
tips: Chain dashes together for extended mobility in skirmishes.
Use your stance-switching mechanic to adapt between engage and disengage tools.
Punish enemies who overextend with your gap-closing combo.
Build a mix of damage and durability to stay relevant throughout fights.
